f.title: Minister may order a person to provide information in their control when a therapeutic product may present a serious risk
f.statement: If the Minister believes that a therapeutic product may present a serious risk of injury to human health, the Minister may order a person to provide the Minister with information that is in the person's control and that the Minister believes is necessary to determine whether the product presents such a risk.
f.clause: s. 3, Food and Drugs Act s. 21.1(1) Power to require information - serious risk
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices, other than natural health products). Addressee must comply with the order (s. 31.2).

f.title: Minister may order an authorization holder to modify the label or modify or replace the package
f.statement: The Minister may, if he or she believes that doing so is necessary to prevent injury to health, order the holder of a therapeutic product authorization that authorizes the import or sale of a therapeutic product to modify the product's label or to modify or replace its package.
f.clause: s. 3, Food and Drugs Act s. 21.2 Modification or replacement - labelling or packaging
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices, other than natural health products). Addressee must comply with the order (s. 31.2).

f.title: Minister may order a seller to recall a product or send it to a specified place when it presents a serious or imminent risk
f.statement: If the Minister believes that a therapeutic product presents a serious or imminent risk of injury to health, the Minister may order a person who sells the product to recall it, or to send it (or cause it to be sent) to a place specified in the order.
f.clause: s. 3, Food and Drugs Act s. 21.3(1) Minister's powers - risk of injury to health
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices, other than natural health products). Addressee must comply with the order (s. 31.2).

f.title: A recall order may require the seller to request owners or users to allow corrective action instead of return
f.statement: For greater certainty, if the Minister makes a recall order under s. 21.3(1)(a) and believes that corrective action is an effective means of dealing with the risk, the order may require the person who sells the product, instead of requesting the product's return, to request the product's owner or user to allow corrective action to be taken in respect of the product and then take that corrective action, or cause it to be taken, if the request is accepted.
f.clause: s. 3, Food and Drugs Act s. 21.3(2) Recall order - corrective action
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices, other than natural health products). Addressee must comply with the order (s. 31.2).

f.statement: Subject to subsection (5), no person shall sell a therapeutic product that the Minister orders them, or another person, to recall.
f.clause: s. 3, Food and Drugs Act s. 21.3(3) Prohibition - selling
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices, other than natural health products)
f.exceptions: Sale authorized by the Minister under s. 21.3(4) and made in accordance with the Minister's conditions (s. 21.3(5)).

f.title: Minister may authorize sale of a recalled product; an authorized sale must follow the Minister's conditions
f.statement: The Minister may authorize a person to sell a therapeutic product, with or without conditions, even if the Minister has ordered them or another person to recall it; a person does not contravene subsection (3) if they sell a product they have been so authorized to sell, provided they sell it in accordance with any conditions the Minister establishes.

f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices, other than natural health products)

f.title: Authorization holders for clinical trials or investigational tests to make prescribed trial information public
f.statement: The holder of a therapeutic product authorization referred to in paragraph 30(1.2)(c) (authorizing a clinical trial or investigational test) shall ensure that prescribed information concerning the clinical trial or investigational test is made public within the prescribed time and in the prescribed manner.

f.title: Minister may order an authorization holder to conduct an assessment of the product and provide the results
f.statement: Subject to the regulations, the Minister may order the holder of a therapeutic product authorization to conduct an assessment of the therapeutic product to which the authorization relates and provide the Minister with the results of the assessment.
f.clause: s. 4, Food and Drugs Act s. 21.31 Power to require assessment
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices, other than natural health products). Addressee must comply with the order (s. 31.2).

f.title: Minister may order an authorization holder to compile information, conduct tests or studies or monitor experience
f.statement: Subject to the regulations, the Minister may, for the purpose of obtaining additional information about a therapeutic product's effects on health or safety, order the holder of a therapeutic product authorization to (a) compile information, conduct tests or studies or monitor experience in respect of the therapeutic product.
f.clause: s. 4, Food and Drugs Act s. 21.32 Power to require tests, studies, etc.
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices, other than natural health products). Addressee must comply with the order (s. 31.2).

f.title: Prescribed health care institutions to report serious ADRs and medical device incidents to the Minister

f.title: Comply with the Act, regulations and orders under ss. 21.1 to 21.32: contravention is an offence
f.statement: Subject to section 31.4, every person who contravenes any provision of the Act or the regulations, as it relates to a therapeutic product, or an order made under any of sections 21.1 to 21.32 is guilty of an offence and liable to penalties.
f.clause: s. 10, Food and Drugs Act s. 31.2 Offences relating to therapeutic products (as amended)
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs and medical devices, other than natural health products)
f.exceptions: Subject to section 31.4 (offences for s. 21.6 and knowingly or recklessly causing a serious risk). Due diligence is a defence (s. 31.3).
